messages.subject: No images in nb.html file
parts:
At some point recently, plot images stopped appearing in my rendered nb.html files, although they continue to appear in rendered .html files as usual.   I tested the R Notebook template with no changes, and I still have this issue. In addition, at times, the code doesn't appear either, with no show/hide toggle, though it is working now.

I have attached the Rmd, html, and nb.html files (or at least tried to... not sure if they'll go through.)


Appreciate any help.

Thanks,
Joyce

Cross-posted here: http://stackoverflow.com/questions/41892783/images-not-showing-in-r-notenook-nb-html-file
